fonts: Bricolage Grotesque 800 (display) · Instrument Sans (body) · JetBrains Mono (outlier), self-hosted in public/fonts, declared in src/styles/global.css @layer fonts
palette: OKLCH via stylex.defineVars in src/styles/tokens.stylex.ts — custom 'Sea Chart': paper oklch(13% 0.025 250), accent oklch(84% 0.16 88), 19-hue tint set for drawings
motion: motion-cut (no framer-motion/gsap/motion); one orchestrated entrance per page, opacity+transform only
note: tokens.stylex.ts is the locked design system; rotation applies to macrostructures only, never to theme.
